summary: One VivaCity camera at Alfred St, Parramatta, split into eight zones. The main fault is multiplied counts: whole days on which the camera published every zone doubled (14 days in 2024-25, only partly caught by the automatic halving) or tripled (2024-10-03), and from Sep 2025 zone-specific windows doubled or tripled within a day; these are halved or set missing. The zones were redefined in Nov 2023-Jan 2024 (road, crossing and far-footpath zones get separate series per configuration, and the degraded 2023-11-24..12-11 spell is missing). From 2025-02-06 the feed leaves out most zero slots, so days look incomplete, but hourly totals match 2024 and the absent slots are zeros; only real partial-day outages are set missing. The 417 M4 path and 407_1181 decline to near zero during 2025 and are kept as real.
